saw_lines: Men buy a tie for one occasion, a wedding or a job interview, then rebuy when the set feels worn out.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where the offer and the proof have to show up.
Your site shows 400,000+ customers and 17,500+ reviews, yet only 1 of 30 ads carries a proof number. Put 17,500+ reviews on the creative and open two ads with a quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 12 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 400,000+ customers and 17,500+ reviews, yet only 1 of 30 ads carries a proof number. Cold buyers need that trust before they click. Put 17,500+ reviews on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote.
Your site offers 30% off sitewide, yet only 1 of 23 ads mention it. New buyers have no price reason to click today. Put the 30% off offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

6 of 23 ads are creator posts with a code or @mention, run from your brand page. Buyers cannot tell who is selling. Whitelist those six from the creator account and cut three variations of the best, tie in frame.
4 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product on screen. A buyer who came for one tie has to search again. Point each of the four to the exact product its ad shows.

ads_1: Sitewide 30% off opening line, backed by 17,500+ reviews on the creative
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X and YouTube
